propositions: Non-existent Jira project keys cause parse errors that abort the entire pass rather than returning empty results, and the stateful fake transport masks this failure mode.
A configured but unmapped project key should fail closed with no write side-effects when queried, and this behavior must be validated in a live multi-project context.

Cross-project ticket contamination cannot be detected with only two shared production projects; throwaway isolated projects are required to model three repo shapes, empty projects, and unknown-project fail-closed paths.
Every mutating scenario must preview-gate before sync to verify the planned mutation set targets only the intended project with empty intersection against other configured projects.
A live rehearsal against the ephemeral DC instance with admin-provisioned scratch projects is reproducible and CI-verified, replacing the failed live-Cloud approach.
The rehearsal must verify multi-project ingest correctness, per-project outbound routing, empty project creation suppression, and session cleanup on all exit paths.
